movement_source: row 'Net interest margin (%)', column Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 -> column Full Year Ended 30 Jun 25
headline: CBA's Group net interest margin rose 9 bps in FY25 to 2.08% from 1.99% in FY24 (results book KPI table, page 28). The bank's own walk (NIM Movement since June 2024) attributes the +9 bps to: Liquids & Pooled Facilities +7 bps, Capital, Replicating and Other +9 bps, Treasury and Markets +1 bps, partly offset by Funding costs -7 bps and Basis risk -1 bps; Asset pricing and Portfolio mix were flat. Excluding the 7 bps from lower-yielding liquid assets and institutional pooled facilities (broadly neutral to net interest income), underlying NIM rose 2 bps. The FY24 endpoint (1.99%) is corroborated in the FY24 profit announcement. The walk sums to the +9 bps movement.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Reduction in lower-yielding liquid assets and institutional pooled lending facilities drove a 5 bps and 2 bps increase in margin respectively (+7 bps total). The bank notes this is broadly neutral to net interest income.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Asset pricing was flat, contributing nothing to the margin movement.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Funding costs decreased margin by 7 bps, driven by increased deposit price competition.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Portfolio mix was flat, contributing nothing to the margin movement.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Basis risk arises from the spread between the 3-month bank bill swap rate and the 3-month overnight index swap rate; margin decreased 1 bps reflecting an increase in the average spread.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Increased margin by 9 bps driven by the net impact of the replicating portfolio due to changes in portfolio rate and volume (up 5 bps) and higher earnings on capital hedges (up 4 bps).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Treasury and Markets increased margin by 1 basis point.

notable_items: Liquids & Pooled Facilities +7 bps is broadly neutral to net interest income
limitations: The FY25 results presentation is not in the corpus; the walk is taken from the FY25 profit announcement (results book), which is the primary framing. The FY24 endpoint (1.99%) is corroborated in the FY24 profit announcement.
The bank reports NIM on a continuing-operations basis; the Group NIM row carries no cash/statutory label and is reported on the bank's primary basis.
The bank does not disclose a separate reason for the flat Asset pricing and Portfolio mix bars beyond 'Flat'.
